original_prompt:
/deep-interview --standard /deep-interview "Restructure /Server for consistency — naming conventions, 
file structure, and code organization only. No behavior changes.

Scope:
- Standardize variable and function naming conventions
- Standardize file/folder structure and naming
- Ensure consistent code organization patterns across files
- Flag any bugs or potential bugs found, but DO NOT fix them

Explicitly out of scope:
- Logic changes
- Bug fixes
- Performance improvements
- New features

After producing the plan, split tasks into two files:

.omc/plans/claude-tasks.md
Tasks requiring judgment — ambiguous naming decisions, structural 
patterns that need a consistent standard decided, anything where 
the right answer isn't obvious from the code alone.

.omc/plans/codex-tasks.md
Mechanical tasks — renaming variables/files to an already-decided 
convention, moving files to an already-decided structure, applying 
a consistent pattern that has already been defined.

Claude tasks must complete first. Write a handoff summary to 
.omc/plans/handoff.md when done, documenting all conventions and 
decisions made so Codex has full context before starting."
